resourceContracts.profiles: Reusable configured Codex roles with editable instructions, enabled state, and selected-project installed skill bindings. JSON import is reviewed before saving; JSON export and starter-profile installation are available. Profiles are separate from live executions.

mariIdentity.stateContract: Portrait motion and fixed eye colors do not convey execution, errors, listening, or talking. The separate caption remains factual. Pause, reduced motion, hidden pages, and offscreen visibility reset the portrait to neutral frame 0; resume restarts the full frontal breathing rest before a lean. Globe styling may reflect factual activity without ambient motion establishing execution.
mariIdentity.logoContract: Remove only the separate graphic illustration logo/emblem. BrandMark export is removed. Retain MARI text title and PERSONAL AI subtitle in Core, header home button, pairing, and loading views. The header home control retains aria-label Command center home.

portraitAnimation.renderer: CSS background positions select complete raster drawings. background-size 600% 400%, transparent absolute bottom-anchored surface at z-index 1; no CSS animation, transition, bobbing, crossfade, morphing, or interpolation.

asset.generation: Built-in image-generation output; no API fallback. Asset provenance is recorded in docs/design/mari-portrait-assets.md.
asset.frameContract: Frames 0–11 are front-facing breathing without a blink. Frames 12–17 draw the left lean, frames 18–23 the right lean; each gesture returns through its own drawings to frontal neutral frame 0.

cycle.order: front × 9 → left lean → neutral → front × 10 → right lean → neutral; repeat
cycle.description: Front-facing breathing is the default; only one lean runs at a time, followed by a long frontal rest. Timings are extracted from src/lib/portrait-motion.js and do not establish browser QA or motion smoothness.

portraitAnimation.stateContract: Decorative and independent of execution, connectivity, service health, and task status. Receives no execution or availability props. No simulated talking/listening; factual caption remains separate.
portraitAnimation.control: Core owns one official ghost icon-sm Button with Pause avatar and globe animation / Resume avatar and globe animation labels. It controls both children through the same paused prop. Child controls remain hidden (showControls=false). Reduced motion disables the shared control; child loading/failure does not.
portraitAnimation.visibility: document.visibilitychange and IntersectionObserver clear the timer and reset frame 0 when hidden/offscreen; resuming restarts the full frontal rest. Passive scroll/resize listeners are the IntersectionObserver fallback.
portraitAnimation.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion takes precedence over Resume, clears the timer, resets neutral frame 0 and the sequence to the full frontal rest, and disables the parent control.
portraitAnimation.loadingAndFailure: Shared preload awaits decode and validates nonzero six-by-four dimensions with square cells. Loading portrait… is plain text; load/decode/shape failure shows Portrait unavailable. Reload to retry. Description explains the state.
portraitAnimation.lifecycle: One pending timeout. Unmount clears it, disconnects observer, removes media/visibility/viewport listeners, clears runtimeRef, and guards pending load callbacks after disposal.
portraitAnimation.accessibility: role=img with Mari character portrait label, aria-busy during loading, and per-instance useId description. Description explains decorative independence, pause, reduced motion, loading, or failure.
portraitAnimation.theme: Surrounding CSS surfaces and globe lines follow selected theme. Raster atlas retains its drawn colors; MARI/PERSONAL AI text remains and the separate graphic illustration logo is removed.

globeAnimation.composition: Active lazy-loaded Three.js globe sits behind the bottom-anchored avatar. Absolute inset 0, z-index 0, opacity 0.44; transparent portrait z-index 1. Core supplies sizeScale={2}: resize doubles the base projected radius/diameter, and the SVG fallback scales geometry by two around its center. Host bounds and clipping remain unchanged.
globeAnimation.control: Same parent-owned paused prop as portrait; own showControls remains false. Reduced motion, pause, hidden pages, and offscreen visibility stop the rendering loop.
globeAnimation.status: Theme/activity line styling reflects factual activity inputs. Ambient movement does not establish execution; the caption states actual task/worker status.
globeAnimation.fallbackAndLifecycle: Static SVG fallback for unavailable WebGL or context loss; context restoration resumes permitted rendering. Cleanup stops the animation loop, removes listeners/observers, disposes geometries/materials/renderer, and clears the scene.

size.diagnostics: WebGL resize exposes data-base-projected-diameter and data-projected-diameter on the host when it has size.

narrative.overview:
Mari preserves the user's selected second concept's compact command-center composition, central assistant area, and readable operational panels. The composition reference is `docs/design/mari-command-center-v2.png`; the first generated concept was rejected. The latest correction uses the v3 24-drawing portrait for front-facing breathing by default, with rare one-sided leans after long frontal rests. The avatar sits at Core’s bottom with a faint Three.js globe behind it at twice its base projected diameter. Retain the MARI text title and PERSONAL AI subtitle; remove only the separate graphic illustration logo. The dark palette still derives from Mari’s coat, hair, gold, and red details. That palette supersedes the earlier pure-black direction. The supplied Grand Chase Mari reference and official [PlayPark character introduction](https://gcc.playpark.com/update/get-acquainted-with-the-awesome-characters/) inform a blue bob, blue/red eyes, thin glasses, gold crest, and high collar. A cold, robotic personality is the user's art direction, not a claim that the character is literally an android.

The home view establishes project, worker, task, and artifact context. Selecting a task enlarges its actual images and decisions in the same page. Horizontal workspace controls expose project management, explicit folder scans, installed Codex skills, and reusable agent profiles. Product state comes from observable execution; configured profiles remain separate from live executions. The portrait uses front-facing drawn breathing and hair motion, with a rare lean to one side, a return to front, and a long rest before another gesture. Keep its reserved expression and closed lips; the first 12 breathing drawings contain no blink. Its animation is decorative and independent of task activity; the factual caption remains separate.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light surfaces and a Mari-inspired midnight dark palette
A bottom-anchored 2D portrait with frontal breathing, rare one-sided leans, and a faint enlarged globe behind it
Blue actions, gold focus, and restrained rose details
Observable execution and dominant selected artifacts
MARI text title and PERSONAL AI subtitle, without a separate graphic illustration logo or navigation sidebar
dos: Do preserve the selected reference's compact command-center composition on this surface.
Do preserve light mode and the latest character-derived dark palette through shared semantic tokens.
Do make the selected artifact and its next decision dominant.
Do show unknown, disconnected, external, and waiting states explicitly.
Do keep service output and agent execution events identifiable.
Do distinguish installed skill context, configured profiles, and live executions.
Do keep the portrait independent of operational state and preserve the separate factual caption.
Do use the v3 raster drawings for frontal breathing and hair motion with rare one-sided leans after long rests, and one shared avatar-and-globe motion control.
Do stop hidden/offscreen work, honor reduced motion, and reset interrupted portrait playback to neutral plus a full frontal rest.
donts: Don't use the decorative red iris as an error signal or animate the portrait in response to work, talking, or listening.
Don't use invented numbers, progress, agents, integrations, or terminal streams.
Don't reintroduce a sidebar, gloss, neon glow, a separate graphic illustration logo, or unrelated dashboard features; retain the MARI/PERSONAL AI text.
Don't restore the rejected six-frame eye-only loop, CSS bobbing, or crossfades between drawings.
Don't promote historical screenshots or the superseded pure-black palette over the latest user direction.
